envelope.description: EpicImpactAnalysis on the LLD and PLAN: type, optional field, sections and first-step schemas

body.title: EpicImpactAnalysis on the LLD and PLAN: type, optional field, sections and first-step schemas
body.summary: Add the EpicImpactAnalysis type ({ applies, reason?, storiesCovered, findings, sources }) and the optional epicImpact field to LldBody (src/workflow/artifacts/lld.ts) and PlanBody (src/workflow/artifacts/plan.ts), each with a section builder that renders an 'Epic impact analysis' section only when the field is present (so existing artifacts and their markdown are byte-for-byte unchanged); add the optional epicImpact to the design.story and plan first-step context schemas (src/workflow/runners/design-story/schemas.ts, src/workflow/runners/plan/schemas.ts). Refresh the module-state and session-source inventory fixtures only for the files this task changes. Tests in epic-impact-artifacts.test.ts (the render part).
acceptanceChecks: an LLD and a PLAN with an epicImpact render an 'Epic impact analysis' section and one without it renders exactly as before (a golden comparison with an existing artifact)
the first-step schemas accept an epicImpact and still accept a context without one
no inventory test case fails beyond the four that already fail on a clean checkout

tests.name: epic-impact-artifacts.test.ts: an LLD and a PLAN with an epicImpact render an 'Epic impact analysis' section, one without it renders exactly as before, and a synthesize with a non-null digest and no analysis (or an empty one) is rejected with the reason
